LIN Transceiver Driver (LinTrcv)

Controls physical bus transceiver states and wakeup on LIN lines.
function LinTrcv_Init [SWS_LinTrcv_00001]
void Lin Trcv_Init(const Lin Trcv_ConfigType* ConfigPtr);
Initializes the Lin Transceiver Driver module.
function LinTrcv_SetOpMode [SWS_LinTrcv_00002]
Std_ReturnType Lin Trcv_Set OpMode(uint8 Lin Network, Lin Trcv_TrcvModeType OpMode);
The internal state of the LIN transceiver driver is switched to mode given in the parameter Op Mode.
function LinTrcv_GetOpMode [SWS_LinTrcv_00005]
Std_ReturnType Lin Trcv_Get OpMode(uint8 Lin Network, Lin Trcv_TrcvModeType* OpMode);
API detects the actual software state of LIN transceiver driv er.
function LinTrcv_GetBusWuReason [SWS_LinTrcv_00007]
Std_ReturnType Lin Trcv_Get Bus Wu Reason(uint8 Lin Network, Lin Trcv_Trcv Wakeup ReasonType* Reason);

This API provides the reason for the wakeup that the LIN transceiver has detected in the parameter "Reason". The ability to dete ct and differentiate the possible wakeup reasons depends strongly on the LIN transceiver hardware.
function LinTrcv_GetVersionInfo [SWS_LinTrcv_00008]
void Lin Trcv_Get VersionInfo(Std_VersionInfoType* versioninfo);
This service provides the version information of this module through the parameter "versioninfo".
function LinTrcv_CheckWakeup [SWS_LinTrcv_00012]
Std_ReturnType Lin Trcv_Check Wakeup(uint8 Lin Network);
Service LinTrcv_CheckWakeup.
function LinTrcv_SetWakeupMode [SWS_LinTrcv_00009]
Std_ReturnType Lin Trcv_Set WakeupMode(uint8 LINNetwork, Lin Trcv_Trcv WakeupModeType Trcv WakupMode);
This API enables, disables and clears the notification for wakeup events on the addressed network. A vailable via Lin Trcv.h

This type denotes the wake up reason detected by the LIN transceiver in detail.
